Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Galveston for 2026, and here is what he found: 7 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from November 13 (The Polar Express train ride at Galveston Railroad Museum) through January 2, with Dickens on the Strand (December 4 to 6), the Galveston Christmas Parade (December 12) and Holiday in the Gardens along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
